svg.title: Optotagging controls, anatomical yield, and regional waveform phenotype overlays
svg.desc: A-B show the optotagging response and overall yield controls. C-D show anatomical yields using the 60-session yield criterion. E retains the separately QC-selected FS, optotagged SST, and overlap labels in all six regional embeddings. The two tagging criteria are not interchangeable.
